overview: The paper proposes ProxyAttn, a training-free sparse attention algorithm that leverages the consistency among attention heads by using pooled proxy heads for fine-grained block importance estimation and dynamic per-head budget allocation to achieve efficient long-context inference in LLMs.

modules.name: Proxy Head Construction Module
modules.description: Left side: Original multi-head query and key matrices. Right side: Compressed proxy head query and key matrices. Functionality: Implements dimension compression along the head number via average pooling within defined groups, aligning with Group-Query Attention structures to generate representative proxy heads.

modules.name: Fine-grained Score Estimation Module
modules.description: Left side: Proxy head query and key matrices. Right side: Unified block-level importance scores. Functionality: Computes token-level dot-product attention scores using proxy heads, applies strided dropout to reduce computation, and utilizes max-pooling to aggregate token-level scores into fine-grained block-level importance scores.

modules.name: Dynamic Budget Allocation Module
modules.description: Left side: Query states from the final block and key states. Right side: Per-head block-aware budget ratios. Functionality: Implements the online budget estimation algorithm, using approximate attention scores from the last block, aggregating them via average pooling, and determining the minimum budget ratio for each head based on a cumulative probability threshold.

modules.name: Sparse Mask Generation Module
modules.description: Left side: Unified block importance scores and per-head budget ratios. Right side: Diverse sparse attention masks for each head. Functionality: Generates the final sparse masks by selecting the top-K blocks with the highest importance scores, constrained by the dynamically estimated per-head budgets, ensuring diverse sparsity patterns.

modules.name: Block Sparse Attention Execution Module
modules.description: Left side: Sparse attention masks and original query, key, value matrices. Right side: Attention output tensors. Functionality: Integrates efficient block sparse attention kernels to execute the attention computation based on the generated sparse masks, enabling hardware-friendly acceleration.

modules.name: Model Adaptation & Integration Module
modules.description: Left side: Standard LLM model architecture and ProxyAttn components. Right side: Modified LLM with integrated ProxyAttn. Functionality: Adapts the ProxyAttn algorithm into mainstream large language model architectures, overriding standard attention during the pre-filling stage while maintaining full attention for decoding.

modules.name: Dataset Processing and Loading Module
modules.description: Left side: Raw data from synthetic and real-world benchmarks. Right side: Tokenized and formatted batches of long-context data. Functionality: Handles the preprocessing, tokenization, and formatting of data, preparing inputs for evaluating long-context capabilities across varying sequence lengths.

modules.name: Baseline Methods Integration Module
modules.description: Left side: Standard LLM model architecture and baseline algorithm specifications. Right side: Modified LLM with baseline sparse attention mechanisms. Functionality: Integrates existing sparse attention baseline methods, ensuring fair comparison by configuring their heuristic templates, dynamic pattern determination, anti-diagonal scoring, or trainable gate mechanisms.

modules.name: Long-Context Benchmark Evaluation Module
modules.description: Left side: Model predictions and ground truth labels. Right side: Task-specific evaluation metrics. Functionality: Executes the evaluation pipelines for specific tasks within the benchmarks, calculating metrics such as RULER scores, retrieval accuracy, and QA accuracy.

modules.name: Computational Efficiency Profiling Module
modules.description: Left side: Execution timestamps and computation traces. Right side: Latency metrics and acceleration ratios. Functionality: Measures and compares the kernel-level attention computation latency and the end-to-end Time to First Token acceleration ratio against baselines, assessing practical inference speedup.

modules.name: Sparsity Rate Calculation Module
modules.description: Left side: Sparse attention masks and sequence lengths. Right side: Weighted sparsity ratio. Functionality: Calculates and tracks the weighted sparsity ratio achieved by different sparse attention methods across varying input lengths to quantify computational reduction.

modules.name: Hyperparameter Sensitivity Analysis Module
modules.description: Left side: Varying hyperparameter configurations. Right side: Performance and sparsity outcomes. Functionality: Conducts ablation studies to evaluate the impact of key hyperparameters, including the cumulative probability threshold, minimum budget constraints, and strided dropout window size.

modules.name: Architectural Ablation Analysis Module
modules.description: Left side: Different model architectures and ablation configurations. Right side: Comparative performance metrics. Functionality: Analyzes the effect of varying the number of proxy heads on different architectures and compares the performance degradation of static versus dynamic budget allocation strategies.

modules.name: Attention Behavior Visualization Module
modules.description: Left side: Raw attention score distributions. Right side: Visual plots and statistics of attention behavior. Functionality: Implements visualization tools to analyze and plot observational characteristics, including token focus overlap, cumulative attention curves, and the influence of sink tokens on head consistency.

modules.name: Experiment Configuration Management Module
modules.description: Left side: Experimental parameters and environment settings. Right side: Structured configuration files and logging streams. Functionality: Manages the experimental setups, including model configurations, dataset paths, baseline hyperparameters, and evaluation settings, ensuring reproducibility and organized execution.
